title: Upgrade Kiichain to v8.0.1
summary:
Coordinated upgrade of Kiichain mainnet to v8.0.1.

The upgrade is scheduled for Tuesday 2026-10-20 around 17:00:00 UTC (block height 11,169,200). Height is estimated from the mainnet block time over the 100,000 blocks ending 2026-10-15 16:45 UTC and should be rechecked before this proposal is submitted.

Validators should download the v8.0.1 binary, verify the checksum, and stage it in cosmovisor under the upgrade plan name v8.0.0 (upgrades/v8.0.0/bin) before the upgrade height.

The plan name stays v8.0.0 because it matches the v8.0.0 upgrade handler included in v8.0.1, which adds the Cosmos SDK x/circuit store and runs module migrations. The same binary must also include the EVM dependency bump to KiiChain/evm v0.6.2-fork.2 (August 2026 security backports). That bump has no upgrade handler of its own, so it is not a separate software-upgrade plan.

Binaries and checksums are not published yet. Fill them in from the v8.0.1 release before submitting this proposal. Do not submit until the release commit contains both the circuit upgrade and the EVM bump.
